tasks.task: We’re doing a customer demo for “Northwind Retail” today and need to ensure there’s no leftover active/closing Playwright session consuming quota. Please find the current session for API key “Customer demo tenant: Northwind Retail” (id cfpw_key_01J8ZB1K5T0X0A7N3G2YQ6M9VF), navigate its active tab to the Cloudflare Playwright docs, wait 2.5 seconds to confirm the page loads (network request logged), then close the tab/session before the demo starts.

success_criteria: A network request event list is returned in step 2 (browser_network_requests) showing a document GET for https://docs.cloudflare.com/browser-rendering/playwright/.
Step 3 (browser_close) returns a session object whose status is "closed" and includes a non-null closed_at timestamp.
After closure, the final browser_network_requests call fails with NOT_FOUND (or returns no events due to the page/session being unavailable), confirming the session/tab is closed.

tasks.task: We need to verify whether the "Growth team: checkout monitoring" automation is making any unexpected outbound calls to Stripe test endpoints, and we must capture evidence before 10:30 UTC today for our security review. Use the existing active page in the current Cloudflare Playwright session to navigate to https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/payments?status=failed&limit=25, wait for the page to settle, pull the last 5 network request events as evidence, then close the page to comply with our policy that security-review sessions must be terminated immediately after evidence is collected.

success_criteria: The network evidence call returns up to 5 events and includes at least one event whose payload.url equals "https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/payments?status=failed&limit=25".
The evidence output includes session_id and tab_id values that can be referenced in the security review report.
